items.title: Plant a Tree! 🌳 Every Bite Is a Good Deed | Islam for Kids #shorts

qa.salutation: Sahil's recorded clip spliced via <SAW> (fixed audio; whisper cannot confirm 'Wa Aalihi')
qa.heard: Look, I have a tiny seed. What will it become?  Listen, our Prophet Muhammad Mustafa,  sallallahu ta'ala alaihi wa ala alaihi wa sallam  taught us, when a Muslim plants a tree and a bird, a person or an animal eats from it,  it counts as a charity for him.  Let's plant!  Dig a little hole, drop in the seed and cover it up.  Splash! Splash!  We give it water every day.  Wow! It grew into a big tree full of apples.  A little bird eats one.  Tweet, tweet. A hungry goat eats one too.  Each little bite counts as a good deed for the one who planted the tree.  What can you plant this week? Ask your grown-up.
